notes.title: Minor Patch 7/1/24
notes.notes: Updated some user interface colors for improved clarity

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Additions:
-Added VR Battle Arena to Beta City southwest.
-New skills available for Bob.
-Added Commentary Mode, enable from Settings menu.
-Minor dialogue additions throughout, clarifying some story events.
-Updated some enemy graphics.
-Redesigned Frozen Queen boss fight.
-New trophies for completing VR battles and reaching level 30 with Bob.
-Heroes who aren’t in the active party now receive some XP after battle.

Balance:
-Increased difficulty of side story boss battles on normal and hard modes during Act 3.
-Increased MP costs for Grant’s skills if he’s using upgrades to reduce charge time.
-Reduced cost of some accessories.
-Adjusted chain % of Salom’s Combo ability.
-Adjusted cost of some hero skills.
-Enemy balance and behavior adjustments throughout.
-Increased Mariella’s base stats.
-Adjusted some enemy elemental weaknesses.

Functionality:
-Updated default palette and standard text boxes for stronger contrast/visibility.
-Updated timing on some captions.
-Updated item descriptions for clarity.

Bugs:
-Fixed a bug where Eli and Alana could be swapped back in after leaving the party.
-Fixed a bug where enemies would not appear in the Mu Shuttle.
-Fixed a bug where HP/MP recovery options were not working properly for certain temporary characters.
-Fixed a couple of incorrectly named maps.
-Minor bug fixes throughout.
-Fixed error message when staying in Bufopolis inn without enough money.
-Fixed incorrect partner being selected during first round of Hank’s coliseum side story if certain choices were made.

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/3/23
notes.notes:
-Adjusted boss stats for Bogmagog battle.
-Typo fixed in Double Poke description.

notes.title: 3/26/23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a misnumbered bestiary entry.
-Minor maptile fixes.
-Fix to prevent a specific key item from being resold after obtaining.
-Fixed a door graphic in Grey Shrine that could appear closed even after opening (did not impede function.)
-Title screen no longer shows Continue or Load Game options if there's no save data to load from.
-Bug fix for rare circumstances where players could continue to move while the main menu is open.
-Fixed a typo on character ability list.

notes.title: 3/22/23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a typo.
-Updated equipment settings for temporary character L.
-Bug fix to one buggy room in Grey Shrine.
-Fixed an issue with stuck text after healing outside of battle depending on party composition.

notes.title: 3/21/23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Minor map tile fixes.
-Removed Extra XP/Gold Earned options from Settings, combining options was causing unexpected errors. May add back later with some changes. For now, enemies on easy mode have received XP/Gold boosts.
-Rebalanced enemy speed stats when battles are set to Active Mode.
-Bug Fix: HP/MP was not being updated on main menu display after healing outside of battle.
-Adding loading screen that pops up in rare circumstances where the game appears to hang for a second.
-Added some fixes for Auto Battle mode.

notes.title: 3/20/23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
3/20/23 Patch Notes
-Added option to reduce screen shake in cutscenes.
-Run button can no longer be used in combination with "Faster move speed on map" setting enabled. Speed became so high that it became possible for graphics to misalign and some cutscenes to glitch.
-Minor adjustments to some cutscene visuals.
-Minor map tile fixes.
-Balance adjustments:
 -Grant: Weight Up now stuns enemies in addition to dealing damage.
 -Woo: Critical hits are more likely to land.
 -Suwanee: Increased damage dealt by poison attacks.
 -Amber: Increased damage dealt by Tylomelania summon.
 -Hank: Increased HP recovery from Tusk attack.
 -Salom: Head Knock is more likely to stun enemies now.
 -Mariella: Equivalent buffs based on heroes she's imitating.
 -Roland: Boosted damage against enemy types depending on weapon upgrade path.
 -Sam: Increased healing power of Pep Up spell.
 -Bob: Increased cost and effect of Focus spell.
